intent: Phase 5 canonical corpus search surface for lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval.
requiredElements: Corpus Search heading and explanatory copy
Lexical, semantic, metadata, and relationship signal chips
Filter rail for family, folder, date, review, and related-document scope
Ranked results with snippets, match strength, and evidence references
Retrieval explanation panel with query interpretation and evidence source jumps
Create review set placeholder action for later review-set workflow
implementationNotes: The Phase 5 React implementation uses project CSS rather than Tailwind.
Relationship-aware signals are represented in the UI as an explicit future seam, but relationship graph execution remains later-phase scope.
Evidence jumps route into the existing viewer surface using document and page context.
